title: The countable Gaussian BRST complex is closed with stable positive degree-zero cohomology

continuum_complex.carrier: The based-gauge factor is symmetric Gaussian Fock over l2, tensored with fermionic exterior Fock over l2 and the K1428 residual-invariant reduced Hilbert space
continuum_complex.core_and_differential: On the algebraic finite-particle core, d is the sum of bosonic annihilation tensored with fermionic creation; d squared is zero and its closure is a densely defined closed operator
continuum_complex.hodge_operator: d d star plus d star d is the total boson-plus-fermion number operator, with kernel the joint vacuum and spectrum at least one on its orthogonal complement
continuum_complex.closed_ranges: The unit spectral gap makes every degreewise range closed; d star N inverse is a bounded contracting homotopy on the positive-number sector
continuum_complex.cohomology: After tensoring with the compatible compact-invariant reduced factor, H0 is the continuum residual-invariant reduced Hilbert space, Hk vanishes for k>0, and the H0 pairing is positive and nonzero
continuum_complex.refinement: Finite-particle block embeddings are chain maps and preserve harmonic representatives, so the positive degree-zero classes are stable under the declared refinement tower
continuum_complex.boundary: This is a continuum Gaussian gauge-fixed Hilbert complex, not a unitary representation of bare noncompact gauge translations, an interacting BRST charge, or source-derived GU physical cohomology
